rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image/Gardner grade was available to it and did not fabricate embryo-specific morphology. It therefore avoided major errors, but it also did not assess the clearly poor/degenerate-looking blastocyst morphology visible in the image.

It integrated most key factors well: age, BMI, ovarian reserve, PCOS, smoking, prior ectopic, semen parameters, endometrium, and fresh-transfer receptivity considerations. Connections to prognosis were generally appropriate, though embryo-image uncertainty limited full integration.

The reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with probability ranges tied to embryo quality uncertainty and patient factors. Minor limitation: the overall optimism may be somewhat high given the actual image, but this follows from the model's stated lack of morphology access.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice: SET in a good-prognosis 32-year-old, luteal support, smoking cessation, ectopic surveillance, antagonist appropriateness in PCOS, and selective rather than routine PGT-A. Slightly generalized but well aligned overall.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including confirming embryo grade, continuing progesterone, smoking cessation, early beta-hCG/ultrasound, considering freeze-all if indicated, and evaluating tubal disease. Useful and case-specific, though not highly detailed operationally.
